closed_scope: All config declarations/defaults/ranges/path aliases and exact packaged field consumers; only MOB_CONFIG_SPEC is registered.
exact_next_task: Native resource and numeric identity closure, independent audits/reproduction, push, STOP.

contracts.actual_behavior: Mod constructs two specs, but LegendaryMonsters registers ONLY MOB_CONFIG_SPEC as COMMON type. Old CommonConfig fields have no packaged reads outside construction; unregistered definitions are not current gameplay defaults. Exact table preserves builder paths/key spelling, native fields, types/default/ranges and all packaged consumer identities; zero-read MobConfig fields remain unused. Comments are not behavior. False defaults: Cloudprojectile, AllowWitheredAbominationStun, TheObliteratorAnnihilationEffect; ordinary other declared booleans true. MiniBoss cap21, Cloud18, Paladin21, Obliterator20; adaptation integer1, anti-airborne integer4, clone HP7, portal HP5, portal explosion HP3. All numeric default/range bindings are observation only, not scaling policy. Native consumers in independently reviewed methods determine actual formulas/dispatch/eligibility; copied field labels and config paths do not establish active attacks. Flameborn Warrior health field uses damage label and damage field health label; field consumer identity determines effect. Music multiplier permits0 and is divisor in client volume expression; no combat effect inferred. Multipliers permit0..1000 (FKnight0..100), live server state overrides external config values; pinned default is not assumed loaded value.
contracts.closest_vanilla_equivalent: NeoForge COMMON config registration, native defaults/ranges and individual mod consumer formulas.
